claims.text: Rehabilitation Counselling is a self-regulating profession in Australia; the Australian Society of Rehabilitation Counsellors (ASORC) accredits members who hold an ASORC-accredited Masters or Graduate Diploma and complete at least 20 hours of continuing professional development annually.

sources.title: Australian Society of Rehabilitation Counsellors
sources.whatItMeasured: ASORC peak-body accreditation standards (AHPA profile), retrieved 2026-08-31

claims.refuteNotes: Source is real (AHPA profile). Population: AU rehab counsellors. Window: current accreditation rules.

claims.text: Rehabilitation Counsellors assess barriers and coordinate return to work, study and community participation for people with injury, disability or disadvantage, frequently delivering services under government programs such as Disability Employment Services and vocational rehabilitation schemes.

sources.title: The Role of Rehabilitation Counsellors
